fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/Homepage/PopularTruckComparison.cy.js#Homepage - PopularTruckComparison [en] TC-PTC-05: no two comparison cards compare the same truck pair
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-PTC-05
**Title:** No two comparison cards compare the same truck pair
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Confirm each visible comparison card compares a distinct pair of trucks. The same truck may appear on several cards against different rivals — that is expected.

**Expected Result:**
No two visible comparison cards list the exact same pair of trucks.

**Steps:**
1. Open Popular Truck Comparison
2. Verify each card’s truck pair is unique
